environment.description: Ktor webhook-gateway service deployed in Kubernetes namespace 'commerce-prod' on GKE 1.28. Pod runs with default service account. No network policies applied. Istio sidecar injected but in PERMISSIVE mTLS mode with no AuthorizationPolicy resources in the mesh. Internal metadata endpoint (169.254.169.254) and other namespace services (e.g., secrets-manager.vault-system.svc.cluster.local:8200) are reachable from the pod network.
